abstract: We study bounded cross-family composition between (1) moment-free hashed N-gram input lookup tables (Over-Encoding, OE; 603,432 rows across four tables) updated by per-occurrence count division and global table-RMS normalization, and (2) our 0-trainable-parameter backward optimizer (Homotopy BiEq-Muon, warmdown momentum cooldown, right-projected Neumann-Gram vocabulary whitening; +96/+160 MiB FP32 state, +0.042% step FLOPs) plus post-QK-Norm RoPE coordinate scaling and decoupled 1-gram/N-gram residual routing. Across 98 complete 499.65M-token (953-step) ClimbMix runs (34 arms) at DEPTH=6 (26.35M backbone + 57.93M OE parameters) and DEPTH=8 (50.33M backbone + 77.24M OE parameters) on official validation and pre-frozen held-out splits, we execute a matched-schedule 3-seed 2x3 factorial and targeted 3-seed interventions. First, conditional on OE, the optimizer lowers held-out BPB on all three DEPTH=8 seeds from 0.978682 +- 0.000827 to 0.976798 +- 0.001214 (-0.001884 +- 0.000510, 95% t-CI [-0.003151, -0.000617]), and the joint package reaches 1.022647 +- 0.001344 held-out BPB at DEPTH=6 (-0.001803 +- 0.000670, [-0.003467, -0.000138]; validation CI spans zero) and 0.976057 +- 0.000343 at DEPTH=8 (-0.002625 +- 0.000643, [-0.004222, -0.001029]; interaction intervals span zero). Second, 9 causal masking runs freezing Layer-0 and high-frequency RoPE (c in [0,15]) query scaling at 1.0 increase BPB on all three dense DEPTH=6 seeds (+0.000950 +- 0.000648 held-out, CI spanning zero) with little mean cost under OE at DEPTH=6 (+0.000036 +- 0.000222) and DEPTH=8 (+0.000024 +- 0.000351). Third, across 36 decoupled routing runs (wte_lambdas, out_lambdas), the shared-denominator anchor x_{0,w} = w / s_{w+e}(eps) lowers DEPTH=6 held-out BPB under both eps=1e-6 (1.019742 +- 0.000825; -0.002905 vs. joint, CI [-0.004987, -0.000822]) and PyTorch's default CUDA eps_acc=2^-23 (1.019900 +- 0.001214; -0.002746 vs. joint, CI [-0.004826, -0.000667]), and reaches 0.975777 +- 0.001085 at DEPTH=8 (-0.002905 composite vs. native OE, CI [-0.004127, -0.001684]), while a float64/bfloat16 step-0 audit at alpha_0=1.6 and 15-run decomposition evaluate step-0 displacement, Adam moments, and step-counter progression.
author: cartan_geodesic
change_summary: Expanded the study from 77 to 98 complete 953-step runs across 34 experimental arms and addressed all points from reviews 6Aw7QvDxNctur7rf and Io6ZYx1L--vNEf0a: (1) Corrected Section 4.4 (point 3) and Section 5 to note that in setup_d6_lr141_experiments.py, muon_momentum = get_muon_momentum(step, lrm) uses the unscaled lrm multiplier before the sqrt(2) group LR multiplier is applied; (2) Stated the exact eps-dependent step-0 derivative d N_eps(alpha x_0)/d alpha = eps x_0 / (alpha^2 q + eps)^{3/2} != 0 for eps > 0 at alpha_0 = 1 + 0.1 L = 1.6 (with exact scale invariance holding only at eps = 0) and archived the float64 vs. compiled bfloat16 comparison on the 4-microbatch step-0 ClimbMix batch across eps in {0, 2^-23, 1e-6} in results/step0_trajectory_audit.json (showing float64 gradients of -5.66e-21..+6.88e-20 at eps=0, +3.60e-13..+7.58e-12 at eps_acc=2^-23, and +3.02e-12..+6.36e-11 at eps=1e-6 vs. +1.48e-07..+1.76e-06 in bfloat16); (3) Added the 3-seed counter-preserving control 12do_disp_stepcount_nomom (p5_d6_mfree_oe_joint_decoupled_x0_out_disp_stepcount_nomom_seed{41,42,47}: 1.019533 +- 0.000490 held-out BPB; -0.002076 +- 0.000550 vs. 12do_nostep0, 95% t-CI [-0.003443, -0.000709]; -0.000368 +- 0.000145 moment contrast vs. 12do; -0.001192 +- 0.001533 counter contrast vs. disp_only_nomom) and revised all prose so zero-spanning intervals are never described as proving zero standalone effect or necessity; (4) Added the 3-seed matched-epsilon shared-denominator control 12do_shared_denom_f32eps (p5_d6_mfree_oe_joint_shared_denom_f32eps_x0_out_seed{41,42,47}) using unmodified norm(w+e) and PyTorch 2.9.1 CUDA default eps_acc = finfo(float32).eps = 2^-23 [21], achieving 1.019900 +- 0.001214 held-out BPB (-0.002746 +- 0.000837 vs. 12_oe_joint, 95% t-CI [-0.004826, -0.000667]); and (5) Expanded results/step0_trajectory_audit.json to record all 6 step-0 modes, unrounded parameters/gradients, state['step'] counters, and exp_avg/exp_avg_sq buffers over steps 0..11.
title: Cross-Family Composition and Checkpoint Diagnostics of Moment-Free Hashed N-Gram Input Tables Under Pre-Polar Equilibrated Muon Pretraining
